arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test various timezone formats
tz530 = parse.FixedTzOffset(-5 * 60 - 30, '-05:30')
tz830 = parse.FixedTzOffset(-8 * 60 - 30, '-08:30')

# Parse with different formats
r1 = parse.parse('{:tt}', '10:21:36 PM -530')
r2 = parse.parse('{:tt}', '10:21:36 PM -05:30')
r3 = parse.parse('{:tt}', '10:21:36 PM -5:30')

print('r1.tzinfo:', r1[0].tzinfo)
print('r2.tzinfo:', r2[0].tzinfo)
print('r3.tzinfo:', r3[0].tzinfo)
print('r1._name:', r1[0].tzinfo._name)
print('r2._name:', r2[0].tzinfo._name)
print('r3._name:', r3[0].tzinfo._name)
print('Equal (r1==r2)?', r1[0].tzinfo == r2[0].tzinfo)
print('Equal (r2==r3)?', r2[0].tzinfo == r3[0].tzinfo)
"
